default_description: A tented camp on a quiet bend of the Mara River, at the foot of the Oloololo Escarpment in Kenya's Maasai Mara. Guided walks with Maasai guides, game drives, river tents and a log cabin over the water.
reservations_hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm East Africa Time
group_line: Exploreans is part of Planhotel Hospitality Group.

newsletter.headline: A note from the river.
newsletter.body: Occasional letters from the camp: when the herds reach the river, what the guides saw this week, and one invitation.
newsletter.success: Thank you. Your first letter arrives with the next story from the river.
